name: Tella
description: Home-brewed grain beer, cloudy and low in alcohol.

tcm.note: Read with beer, which TCM reads as cold.

histamine.note: An unfiltered home ferment — higher than commercial beer.

effects.note: Alcohol measurably slows reaction time and narrows attention at ordinary drinking doses, well before intoxication feels subjectively obvious — one of the most consistently replicated findings in pharmacology, and the reason legal drink-driving limits exist at all. Low-alcohol as home-brewed beer goes, a full bowl of it still delivers enough to produce it. A possible effect, not a promise — response to it varies from person to person.
